items.markdown:
Customer Lifetime Value (CLV or LTV) is `the total net profit or revenue a business expects to earn from a customer throughout their entire relationship`.[[1]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/customer-lifetime-value-clv-calculator/)[[2]](https://www.productlift.dev/clv-calculator/)[[3]](https://www.flowlu.com/tools/clv-calculator/)

CLV=Average Purchase Value×Purchase Frequency×Customer Lifespan×Profit Margin CLV equals Average Purchase Value cross Purchase Frequency cross Customer Lifespan cross Profit Margin C L V=A v e r a g e P u r c h a s e V a l u e×P u r c h a s e F r e q u e n c y×C u s t o m e r L i f e s p a n×P r o f i t M a r g i n

- **Average Purchase Value:** Total revenue divided by the total number of purchases.
- **Purchase Frequency:** Average number of purchases a customer makes per year.
- **Customer Lifespan:** How many years (or months) a typical customer stays with your business.
- **Profit Margin:** The share of revenue that remains as profit after costs.[[1]](https://www.productlift.dev/clv-calculator/)[[2]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/customer-lifetime-value-clv-calculator/)



---

### Alternative Formula (Using Churn Rate)

For subscription or SaaS businesses, CLV is often calculated using monthly or annual churn (the rate at which customers cancel):[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NPNoEqR70W0)[[2]](https://usermaven.com/free-tools/clv-calculator)

CLV=Average Revenue Per Account (ARPA)×Gross Margin %Churn Rate %CLV equals the fraction with numerator Average Revenue Per Account (ARPA) cross Gross Margin % and denominator Churn Rate % end-fraction C L V=A v e r a g e R e v e n u e P e r A c c o u n t(A R P A)×G r o s s M a r g i n%C h u r n R a t e%

- Use the [Flowlu CLV Calculator](https://www.flowlu.com/tools/clv-calculator/) to factor in Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).[[1]](https://www.flowlu.com/tools/clv-calculator/)[[2]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/customer-lifetime-value-clv-calculator/)[[3]](https://usermaven.com/free-tools/clv-calculator)
